theme.description: System follows your device's light or dark setting.

install.description: Add Restart to your Home Screen to open it like any other app. On iPhone, it's needed for notifications.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Reminders, the daily report and the weekly review on this device.

prefs.lead: Remind me before a habit's time
prefs.leadValue: {minutes, plural, =0 {At the time} other {# min before}}
prefs.reportHint: Your score and what's left, at the end of the day.
prefs.quietHint: Nothing is sent between these times.

account.title: Account
account.description: Signing out of all devices also signs you out on your other phones and computers.

routines.title: Routines
routines.description: Groups of habits at a time of day. Deleting one moves its habits to Anytime.
routines.name: Name
routines.digest: Notify me at the start with what's left

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Deleting one leaves its habits without a category.
categories.name: Name

days.title: Days and limits
days.dayEndHint: Late nights count for the day before until this time.

calendar.title: Google Calendar
calendar.description: See your habits next to your events, in a calendar of their own.
calendar.notConfigured: Google Calendar isn't set up on this server yet (GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY).
calendar.intro: Restart creates a “Habits” calendar and only ever touches that one. Habits with fixed days and a time appear as recurring events; done days get a ✅.
calendar.unverified: Google may say the app isn't verified: choose Advanced → Go to Restart.
calendar.needsReauth: Google access expired. Reconnect to keep your calendar up to date.
calendar.disconnectDescription: Syncing stops and Restart's access is revoked.
calendar.deleteCalendar: Also delete the Habits calendar from Google
calendar.connectedToast: Google Calendar connected. Your habits will appear in a minute.
calendar.errorToast: Couldn't connect Google Calendar. Try again.
calendar.banner: Google Calendar needs you to reconnect.
